name: Omote-Sando
tagline: Shibuya in 3 minutes and Toranomon in 10 minutes. Served by 3 lines. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥180,000 to ¥190,000.
summary: The station is in Minato City, served by Tokyo Metro Ginza Line, Tokyo Metro Chiyoda Line and Tokyo Metro Hanzomon Line. Journey times to the main business districts are 14 minutes to Otemachi, 13 minutes to Shinjuku, 3 minutes to Shibuya and 24 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥180,000 to ¥190,000. The station stands 33.6 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 10.7 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 33.6 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 23.6 m to 34.3 m, a difference of 10.7 m. These figures were read from the elevation API of the Geospatial Information Authority of Japan at nine points: the station itself and eight compass directions 400 m out.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, neither the station nor any of the nine points within 400 m of it falls inside the projected inundation area. The projected depth differs block by block within the same station area, so check the ward hazard map for the specific address. Inland flooding from overwhelmed drains has no nationwide map; each ward publishes its own, and that is worth reading as well.
medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 22 clinics and 17 pharmacies. Facilities recorded as hospitals lie at 伊藤病院, about 190 m away and 北青山病院, about 210 m away. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 3 lines serve the station: Tokyo Metro Ginza Line, Tokyo Metro Chiyoda Line and Tokyo Metro Hanzomon Line. All 3 lines are run by Tokyo Metro, so a fault affecting that company can stop them together. Scored out of 100 from the number of lines and the spread of operators, transfer convenience here comes to 68.

rentRange.note: One room ¥180,000 to ¥190,000, 1K ¥150,000 to ¥160,000, 1LDK ¥310,000 to ¥320,000 and 2LDK ¥530,000 to ¥540,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥180,000 to ¥190,000. For One room, 1LDK, 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: Omote-Sando is ahead on the number of lines.
neighbours.note: 771 m away in a straight line. It takes 5 minutes longer to reach Otemachi than Omote-Sando. One-room rents run about ¥9,000 higher.

neighbours.lead: Meiji-Jingumae is ahead on quiet, but Omote-Sando is ahead on how little of the area is in the flood projection and the number of medical facilities.
neighbours.note: 883 m away in a straight line. It reaches Otemachi in about the same time as Omote-Sando.

goodFor: People commuting to Otemachi and Marunouchi
People who want another route when a line stops
People avoiding projected flood inundation areas
notFor: People who want to hold the rent down
noiseSources: 表参道 (3 lanes each way) runs 2 m away, right beside the station. Traffic on it never stops
青山通り (4 lanes each way) runs 14 m away, right beside the station. Traffic on it never stops

leads.terrain: There are gentle slopes around the station, and which block you live on changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: There are 7 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 1 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: Among the 23 wards' stations, very few of the points around this one fall inside the projected inundation area for the largest rainfall the government models.
leads.stationNote: 2 lines serve the station, and the choice of connections is wider than at most stations in the 23 wards.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are among the highest in the 23 wards.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is among the highest in the 23 wards.
leads.noiseSources: At this station, check the traffic noise before the noise people make: 表参道 runs 2 m away.
